result.title: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
result.summary: Irregular time series are recorded at nonuniform times and are often queried at other times: between observations, after the last one, or on a regular grid. Continuous-time models answer such queries by integrating latent dynamics, and time-aware attention models answer them by revisiting the observation tokens. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), an attention operator that writes an irregular history into a rank-M function space with explicit time coordinates. Masked self-attention first exchanges content among the observations; the updated values are then contracted against kernel-smoothed HiPPO-Legendre features and solved through a regularized Gram matrix, so the retained coefficients define a function that is read at any time through the same features. The write and read have the form of an interdomain sparse Gaussian-process mean: every readout lies in an M-dimensional reproducing-kernel subspace, and a pointwise bound separates the approximation error of this subspace from the error of the learned memory. Removing the functional memory from the encoder raises Spiral reconstruction RMSE 18-fold. The full model has the lowest error in 11 of 12 Spiral settings, the highest overall accuracy and best average rank on 20 irregular UEA datasets, the highest event-type accuracy on all five multi-type event benchmarks, and a 21% lower extrapolation MSE than CRU on PhysioNet. Because the memory has fixed rank, the state retained after encoding keeps a fixed size as the history grows and is 102 times smaller than a token cache at 1,024 observations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HiPPO-FM：先用 masked self-attention 在观测间交换内容，再把更新后的值投影到核平滑的 HiPPO-Legendre 特征上，经正则化 Gram 求解得到 rank-M 函数系数，从而把不规则历史写成可在任意时间坐标读取的固定大小状态，并给出子空间近似误差界；在 Spiral、UEA、事件与 PhysioNet 上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 固定秩、按坐标查询的函数记忆及「子空间近似误差与学习记忆误差」的分离，可能为 LVR 中紧凑 latent 状态如何写入视觉证据、按需读取及容量/信息坍缩分析提供可核查的方法线索，但跨模态迁移尚待检验。
